scope: Manual inspection of explicitly listed current-run PNGs plus automated trace crosscheck. No earlier run or instrumented-probe frames reused.

observations.finding: Inspected all eight startup inconclusives. One or two panes contain synthetic output; new panes are blank or show cursor before their fixture paint. Existing glyphs and markers are visually proportionate. Missing markers remain inconclusive under the three-pane oracle.

Main top markers sit at y197 versus y195 in adjacent407 and409; the visible titlebar/window composition is also displaced about2pixels. This is a captured composition/position discontinuity, not measured main-marker scaling. It remains inconclusive; the window-only recording cannot attribute it to SCK alone or certify what appeared on the physical display.

Representative programmatic-resize image shows the intended left stacked/right spanning panes, proportionate glyphs, and102x82 markers. Retained-content boundaries differ from the resized pane bounds in this intermediate frame; no same-frame native offset oracle is available.

recorded_summary.oracle_scope: absolute marker dimensions and visible PTY generation only; no native pane-local reference or drawable presented-handler proof
recorded_summary.scope: Pane-specific absolute dimensions and checksum-visible PTY generations only; offsets, gaps, incomplete and inconclusive samples are not verified.

limitations: No physical-display guarantee or complete display-frame coverage: SCK requested60fps, but statuses/PTS gaps are retained. Candidate has11 timestamp gaps; negative has214; these are not isolated performance benchmarks.

No actual MTLDrawable presented-handler proof, same-frame native pane-local offset references, or AppKit live-resize begin/end callbacks. Phase effectiveness comes from changed PTY geometry plus captured callbacks; callback receipt time can lag acquisition.

Correct classification means absolute marker dimensions and validated barcode where available, not every glyph/pixel/offset verified. Inconclusive frames are not converted to passing frames by manual inspection.
Negative failure classification takes priority over inconclusive panes, so zero inconclusive_complete_frames in that run does not mean no markers were missing during startup.
Videos are finalized and hash-linked; this review inspected listed PNGs and traces, not every video frame.
